Name: A Prefrontal Cortex Map based on Single Neuron Activity
Description: Brain-wide high-density extracellular recordings (Neuropixels) in head-fixed mice during distinct passive listening and auditory behavioral tasks. About half of the recordings are in the prefrontal cortex (PFC) and half from other brain regions (3 cortical and 10 subcortical). In PFC we include 11 subregions: secondary motor area (MOs), anterior cingulate area – dorsal and ventral part (ACAd, ACAv), prelimbic area (PL), infralimbic area (ILA), orbital area – medial, lateral, and ventrolateral part (ORBm, ORBvl, ORBl), agranular insular area – dorsal and ventral part (AId, AIv), and frontal pole (FRP).
